handoff_instructions.purpose: Handoffs document the current state and scope of the project so a new LLM session can pick up exactly where the last one left off. They are the primary continuity mechanism for this project.
what_to_include: A summary of what was done, discussed, built, or decided in this session
What worked and what did not work
Current pipeline state — what scripts exist, what their status is, what the next steps are
A condensed recap of prior sessions so the new LLM has full project context without reading every previous handoff
Open questions or blockers that carry into the next session
what_not_to_include: Exhaustive code listings — reference file paths instead
Decisions that were reversed or abandoned mid-session — only document final state
Speculation about distant future work — stay close to what is actually next
format_rules: This handoff_instructions block must appear at the top of every future handoff
When a user says 'create a handoff for this session,' use this block as the template and fill in the session-specific fields
Prior session summaries should be condensed — one paragraph per session, not a full retelling
Be brief but complete. A new LLM should be able to start working immediately after reading this file

claude_fable_5_facts.thinking: adaptive only (always on — cannot disable with type:disabled, omit the param instead)
claude_fable_5_facts.vision: yes — all current Claude models support image + document input
claude_fable_5_facts.pdf_support: yes — via document content blocks (URL, base64, or Files API file_id)
claude_fable_5_facts.pdf_limits: 600 pages per request (100 for 200k-context models), 32 MB max request size
claude_fable_5_facts.pdf_mechanism: Each page is rendered as an image + text extracted. Claude sees both layers. Supports charts, diagrams, tables.
claude_fable_5_facts.sampling_params: temperature, top_p, top_k all removed (will 400 if sent)

anthropic_pdf_api_reference.note: Anthropic does NOT have a separate 'Document AI' section like Gemini. PDF support is built into the standard Messages API via the document content block type.

implication_for_m3_infer.current_state: gemini_extract() uses the Google Generative AI SDK. claude_infer() uses the Anthropic SDK. These are separate APIs.
implication_for_m3_infer.to_use_fable5_for_extraction: Would require rewriting gemini_extract() to use anthropic.Anthropic() client with document content blocks — not a simple env var swap.
implication_for_m3_infer.decision: Not made yet. Option exists if Gemini extraction accuracy remains insufficient after the session 9.3 prompt improvements are tested.

token_efficiency_note.problem: Invoking the claude-api skill for a simple model capability question consumed ~80-100k tokens because the skill loads the entire Anthropic SDK documentation suite (28+ doc files) as context.
token_efficiency_note.fix: For questions about model capabilities, pricing, or PDF/vision support, use WebFetch directly to the relevant docs pages. The two pages needed for this session were: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview.md and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support.md
token_efficiency_note.when_to_use_claude_api_skill: Only when actually writing code that calls the Anthropic SDK — not for confirming model capabilities.
